plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: the bottle anchors the left, a left-aligned column of logo, headline and subheadline sits beside it, and a properly proportioned CTA closes the line on the right, vertically centred.
Brand-and-message first: logo and copy lead on the left, the bottle sits as a centred visual pivot, and the CTA closes on the right, so the eye goes brand, then headline, then product, then action.
Editorial stack: logo, headline, subheadline and CTA form one tight left-aligned block (the button sits right under its copy), with the bottle on the right as a counterweight across open space.
